event_label: Women of working age (15–74) in the labour force: share unemployed (NH21, 2025). On the scale: approximate probability / share as a decimal.
PA101 (2025, all NACE sectors): estimated share of employees earning above the national mean gross monthly wage (2092 €). Decile-based linear interpolation (approximate).
HT309 (2025, citizenship / kodakondsus): estimated share of university students in Estonia with non-European citizenship (continental aggregates; 1996 of 47496 including unknown region).
HT62 (2025, vocational total, sex total): share of curriculum leavers whose mother tongue is not Estonian (Russian + other + unknown; 1532 of 5162).

Census-style population (2021, end of year): if you picked a person at random from the whole-country total (all ages, both sexes), this is roughly the chance they are counted as ethnic Estonian in the statistics—not the same as citizenship. About 919,711 out of 1,331,824 people.

Same 2021 population snapshot: most people live in ordinary housing (a standard house or flat in the stats, not dorms, homelessness, or odd edge categories). This point is that share—about 1,307,016 in every 1,331,824 counted people nationwide, all ages, both sexes.
